+require "fileutils"
+
+class ImportsController < ApplicationController
+     before_action :require_completed_profile
+  before_action :require_admin
+  before_action :load_import_file, only: %i[preview confirm]
+
+  MAX_FILE_BYTES = 10.megabytes
+  BOOLEAN_LIKE = %w[true false yes no y n x].freeze
+
+  def new
+  end
+
+  def create
+       file = params[:file]
+    return render_invalid("Please upload a .csv file.") unless csv?(file)
+    return render_invalid("File is too large (max 10 MB).") if file.size > MAX_FILE_BYTES
+
+    token = SecureRandom.uuid
+    path = import_path(token)
+    FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(path))
+    File.binwrite(path, file.read)
+
+    redirect_to preview_import_path(token)
+  end
+
+  def preview
+       parser = MemberImport::Parser.new(@path)
+       @headers = parser.headers
+       @requirements = Requirement.where(is_active: true).order(:id).to_a
+       @default_requirement_id = params[:default_requirement_id].presence
+       @sample_rows = parser.rows.first(20)
+
+       @mapping = mapping_params.presence ||
+                  auto_detect_mapping(@headers, parser.rows.first(5))
+       @mapping = apply_default_requirement(@mapping)
+
+       @preview_rows = MemberImport::Mapper.new(rows: parser.rows, mapping: @mapping).preview
+     rescue CSV::MalformedCSVError => e
+          Rails.logger.error("CSV parse failed: #{e.message}")
+       File.delete(@path) if File.exist?(@path)
+       redirect_to new_import_path, alert: "That file isn't valid CSV: #{e.message}"
+  end
+
+  def confirm
+       parser = MemberImport::Parser.new(@path)
+    rows = MemberImport::Mapper.new(rows: parser.rows, mapping: mapping_params).preview
+
+    created = MemberImport::Executor.new(rows).call
+    skipped = rows.count { |r| r.status == :skip }
+    errored = rows.count { |r| r.status == :error }
+
+    File.delete(@path) if File.exist?(@path)
+
+    message = "#{created} member#{'s' if created != 1} added, #{skipped} skipped."
+    message += " #{errored} row#{'s' if errored != 1} had issues." if errored.positive?
+
+    redirect_to members_path, notice: message
+  end
+
+  private
+
+       def csv?(file)
+            file.is_a?(ActionDispatch::Http::UploadedFile) &&
+              File.extname(file.original_filename).downcase == ".csv"
+       end
+
+  def render_invalid(message)
+       flash.now[:alert] = message
+    render :new, status: :unprocessable_entity
+  end
+
+  def import_path(token)
+       Rails.root.join("tmp", "imports", "#{token}.csv").to_s
+  end
+
+  def load_import_file
+       token = params[:token].to_s
+    unless token.match?(/\A[0-9a-f-]{36}\z/)
+         return redirect_to new_import_path, alert: "Invalid import."
+    end
+    @path = import_path(token)
+    unless File.exist?(@path)
+         redirect_to new_import_path, alert: "Import expired. Please upload again."
+    end
+  end
+
+  def mapping_params
+       raw = params[:mapping]
+    return {} if raw.blank?
+    raw.permit(*raw.keys).to_h
+  end
+
+  def auto_detect_mapping(headers, sample_rows)
+       reqs = Requirement.where(is_active: true).to_a
+    headers.each_with_index.to_h do |h, i|
+         key = h.to_s.downcase.strip
+      values = sample_rows.map { |r| r[i].to_s.strip }.reject(&:empty?)
+      field = key.empty? ? blank_header_guess(values) : detect_field(key, reqs)
+      [ i.to_s, field ]
+    end
+  end
+
+  def detect_field(key, reqs)
+       return "email"      if key.include?("email")
+    return "first_name" if key =~ /first.*name/
+    return "last_name"  if key =~ /last.*name/
+    return "full_name"  if key =~ /^(name|full.*name)$/
+    return "paid_dues"  if key.include?("dues")
+
+    req = reqs.find { |r| r.name.to_s.downcase == key }
+    req ? "requirement:#{req.id}" : "ignore"
+  end
+
+  def blank_header_guess(values)
+       return "ignore" if values.empty?
+
+    looks_like_name = values.all? do |v|
+         v.match?(/\A[A-Za-z][A-Za-z\s'.\-\/]+\z/) && v.include?(" ") && !v.include?("@")
+    end
+
+    looks_like_name ? "full_name" : "ignore"
+  end
+
+  def apply_default_requirement(mapping)
+       req_id = @default_requirement_id.to_s
+    return mapping if req_id.blank?
+
+    mapping.each do |col, field|
+         next unless field == "ignore"
+      values = @sample_rows.map { |r| r[col.to_i].to_s.strip }.reject(&:empty?)
+      next if values.empty?
+      next unless values.all? { |v| BOOLEAN_LIKE.include?(v.downcase) }
+      mapping[col] = "requirement:#{req_id}"
+    end
+    mapping
+  end
+end

+module MemberImport
+     class Executor
+          def initialize(preview_rows)
+               @rows = preview_rows
+            @role = Role.find_by!(description: "Member")
+          end
+
+       def call
+            created = 0
+         Member.transaction do
+              @rows.each do |row|
+                   next unless row.status == :valid
+
+                member = Member.create!(
+                  row.attributes.merge(role: @role, joined_at: Date.current)
+                )
+
+                Array(row.points).each do |p|
+                     member.point_entries.create!(
+                       requirement_id: p[:requirement_id],
+                       point_amount: p[:point_amount],
+                       awarded_date: Date.current,
+                       note: "Imported from spreadsheet"
+                     )
+                end
+
+                created += 1
+              end
+         end
+         created
+       end
+     end
+end

+module MemberImport
+     class Mapper
+          Row = Struct.new(:index, :raw, :attributes, :points, :status, :errors, keyword_init: true)
+
+       MEMBER_FIELDS = %w[email first_name last_name full_name paid_dues].freeze
+       REQUIREMENT_PREFIX = "requirement:".freeze
+       TRUTHY = %w[true yes y x].freeze
+       FALSY  = %w[false no n].freeze
+
+       def initialize(rows:, mapping:)
+            @rows = rows
+         @mapping = mapping.to_h.transform_keys(&:to_s).transform_values(&:to_s)
+       end
+
+       def preview
+            @preview ||= @rows.each_with_index.map { |raw, i| build_row(i, raw) }
+       end
+
+       private
+
+            def build_row(index, raw)
+                 attrs = {}
+              points = []
+
+              @mapping.each do |col, field|
+                   value = raw[col.to_i].to_s.strip
+
+                if field.start_with?(REQUIREMENT_PREFIX)
+                     req_id = field.delete_prefix(REQUIREMENT_PREFIX).to_i
+                  amount = points_from_value(value)
+                  points << { requirement_id: req_id, point_amount: amount } if amount.positive?
+                elsif MEMBER_FIELDS.include?(field)
+                     apply_member_field(attrs, field, value)
+                end
+              end
+
+              errors = validate(attrs)
+              status = if errors.any? then :error
+              elsif duplicate?(attrs[:email]) then :skip
+              else :valid
+              end
+
+              Row.new(index: index + 2, raw: raw, attributes: attrs, points: points,
+                      status: status, errors: errors)
+            end
+
+       def points_from_value(value)
+            v = value.to_s.strip.downcase
+         return 0 if v.empty?
+         return 0 if FALSY.include?(v)
+         return 1 if TRUTHY.include?(v)
+
+         n = Integer(v, exception: false)
+         n && n.positive? ? n : 0
+       end
+
+       def apply_member_field(attrs, field, value)
+            return if value.empty?
+
+         case field
+         when "full_name"
+              parts = value.split(/\s+/)
+           attrs[:first_name] ||= parts.first
+           attrs[:last_name]  ||= parts[1..].join(" ") if parts.length > 1
+         when "paid_dues"
+              attrs[:paid_dues] = TRUTHY.include?(value.downcase)
+         when "email"
+              attrs[:email] = value.downcase
+         else
+              attrs[field.to_sym] = value
+         end
+       end
+
+       def validate(attrs)
+            errs = []
+         errs << "Missing email" if attrs[:email].blank?
+         if attrs[:email].present? && !attrs[:email].match?(URI::MailTo::EMAIL_REGEXP)
+              errs << "Invalid email"
+         end
+         errs
+       end
+
+       def duplicate?(email)
+            return false if email.blank?
+         Member.where("LOWER(email) = ?", email.downcase).exists?
+       end
+     end
+end

+require "csv"
+
+module MemberImport
+     class Parser
+          def initialize(path)
+               @path = path.to_s
+          end
+
+       def headers
+            @headers ||= all_rows.first.to_a.map(&:to_s)
+       end
+
+       def rows
+            @rows ||= all_rows.drop(1).map { |r| r.map { |v| v.to_s } }
+       end
+
+       private
+
+            def all_rows
+                 @all_rows ||= CSV.read(@path, headers: false, encoding: "bom|utf-8")
+            end
+     end
+end

+require "rails_helper"
+
+RSpec.describe "Imports", type: :request do
+     let(:admin)   { create(:member, :admin, :profile_completed) }
+  let(:regular) { create(:member, :profile_completed) }
+
+  describe "GET /imports/new" do
+       it "shows the form to admins" do
+            sign_in admin
+         get new_import_path
+         expect(response).to have_http_status(:ok)
+         expect(response.body).to include("Import Members")
+       end
+
+    it "redirects regular members" do
+         sign_in regular
+      get new_import_path
+      expect(response).to redirect_to(root_path)
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "POST /imports" do
+       before { sign_in admin }
+
+    it "rejects non-csv uploads" do
+         file = Rack::Test::UploadedFile.new(
+           Rails.root.join("spec/fixtures/files/bad.txt"), "text/plain"
+         )
+      post imports_path, params: { file: file }
+      expect(response).to have_http_status(:unprocessable_entity)
+      expect(response.body).to include("Please upload a .csv file")
+    end
+
+    it "stores the file and redirects to preview" do
+         allow(MemberImport::Parser).to receive(:new).and_return(
+           instance_double(MemberImport::Parser, headers: [ "Email" ], rows: [])
+         )
+      file = Rack::Test::UploadedFile.new(
+        Rails.root.join("spec/fixtures/files/members.csv"), "text/csv"
+      )
+      post imports_path, params: { file: file }
+      expect(response).to redirect_to(%r{/imports/[0-9a-f-]+/preview})
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "POST /imports/:token/confirm" do
+       before { sign_in admin }
+
+    let(:token) { SecureRandom.uuid }
+    let(:path)  { Rails.root.join("tmp", "imports", "#{token}.csv") }
+
+    before do
+         FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(path))
+        File.binwrite(path, "Email\nnew@tamu.edu\n")
+        allow(MemberImport::Parser).to receive(:new).and_return(
+        instance_double(MemberImport::Parser,
+            headers: [ "Email" ],
+            rows: [ [ "new@tamu.edu" ] ])
+        )
+    end
+
+    it "creates members and redirects to the members list with a summary" do
+         expect {
+              post confirm_import_path(token), params: { mapping: { "0" => "email" } }
+         }.to change(Member, :count).by(1)
+
+        expect(response).to redirect_to(members_path)
+        follow_redirect!
+        expect(response.body).to include("1 member added")
+    end
+  end
+
+  describe "GET /imports/:token/preview with malformed CSV" do
+       before { sign_in admin }
+
+    let(:token) { SecureRandom.uuid }
+    let(:path)  { Rails.root.join("tmp", "imports", "#{token}.csv") }
+
+    before do
+         FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(path))
+      File.binwrite(path, %(Email,Name\n"unterminated,Alice\n))
+    end
+
+    it "redirects back to new with an alert" do
+         get preview_import_path(token)
+      expect(response).to redirect_to(new_import_path)
+      follow_redirect!
+      expect(CGI.unescapeHTML(response.body)).to include("isn't valid CSV")
+    end
+  end
+end

+require "rails_helper"
+
+RSpec.describe MemberImport::Mapper do
+     let(:mapping) { { "0" => "email", "1" => "full_name", "2" => "paid_dues" } }
+
+  def map(rows)
+       described_class.new(rows: rows, mapping: mapping).preview
+  end
+
+  it "marks valid rows as :valid" do
+       row = map([ [ "alice@tamu.edu", "Alice Nguyen", "True" ] ]).first
+    expect(row.status).to eq(:valid)
+    expect(row.attributes).to include(
+      email: "alice@tamu.edu", first_name: "Alice",
+      last_name: "Nguyen", paid_dues: true
+    )
+  end
+
+  it "flags missing emails" do
+       row = map([ [ "", "Alice Nguyen", "True" ] ]).first
+    expect(row.status).to eq(:error)
+    expect(row.errors).to include("Missing email")
+  end
+
+  it "flags invalid emails" do
+       row = map([ [ "not-an-email", "Alice", "True" ] ]).first
+    expect(row.errors).to include("Invalid email")
+  end
+
+  it "marks rows as :skip when the email already exists" do
+       create(:member, email: "alice@tamu.edu")
+    row = map([ [ "alice@tamu.edu", "Alice", "True" ] ]).first
+    expect(row.status).to eq(:skip)
+  end
+end
